name: t13-perc
idea_origin: Leah's stat-perception line (lab/reports/stat-perception/): t13-final (T20) with its Output mark rewritten from the measured Output errors
hypothesis: t13-final's review-month reference marks options that 'give up time from your own delivery' as costing Output, which is the misreading measured in the stat-perception line (Haiku treats time spent as an Output cost; the game lowers Output when you disengage). Asking to consider all five stats and marking disengagement instead should cut lost Network or Output points in the month before a review.
predicted_behaviour: On the T20 bank's pre_review items, fewer choices that lose a needed point and lower regret than t13-final; on the general block, choices barely change (the reference is only read with Review in 1).
refutation: No fewer lost points before reviews than t13-final on the same items, or a fingerprint on the general block above 1 in 10 changed choices.
